resources.string: Temporary owner-requested remote support from your Mac. After you tap Start support and allow screen capture, shares downscaled screen images plus visible buttons and text in Bear Steam, Mr. Steam, Chrome and Settings, and permits taps, swipes, navigation and non-password text entry. Password fields, installers, permission screens and Accessibility or security settings are never sent or operated. No microphone, camera or private app files. A visible Stop control ends the session. Sessions expire after 2 hours and stop when the screen locks. Enabling this service alone does not start support.
